links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of standalone AI vs AI-assisted radiologists for ICH
links.effect: Radiologists with AI outperformed standalone AI: sensitivity 98.91% vs 95.91%, specificity 99.83% vs 87.35%, accuracy 99.53% vs 90.11% (p<0.001); false positives 293 vs 4.
links.quote: Radiologists demonstrated statistically significant superiority across all main diagnostic metrics.

links.outcome: Radiologist review catching ICH cases missed (labeled negative) by AI
links.effect: All 45 ICH cases missed by AI were diagnosed by radiologists; AI missed 4.09% vs radiologists 1.09%.
links.quote: Conversely, in all 45 CT studies where AI services did not detect hemorrhages, pathology was identified by radiologists.

unlisted_practices: Using AI as a second reader with delayed (e.g., end-of-shift) batch verification of AI-positive results to limit false-positive burden

links.outcome: Diagnostic sensitivity, specificity, and accuracy for intracranial hemorrhage
links.effect: Radiologists with AI access versus standalone AI: sensitivity 98.91% vs. 95.91%, specificity 99.83% vs. 87.35%, and accuracy 99.53% vs. 90.11% (p < 0.001).
links.quote: Sensitivity was 98.91% vs. 95.91% for AI, specificity was 99.83% vs. 87.35%, and overall accuracy was 99.53% vs. 90.11%.

links.outcome: Radiologist detection of intracranial hemorrhages missed by AI
links.effect: Radiologists identified all 45 ICH cases missed by AI (4.09%). Radiologists missed 12 cases (1.09%), all identified by AI.
links.quote: Complete complementarity of ICH misses was observed: all 12 cases undetected by radiologists were identified by AI, while all 45 cases missed by AI were diagnosed by radiologists.

links.effect: Radiologists using AI as an adjunct significantly outperformed standalone AI services in sensitivity (98.91% vs. 95.91%), specificity (99.83% vs. 87.35%), and overall accuracy (99.53% vs. 90.11%).
links.quote: Radiologists with AI assistance statistically significantly outperformed AI services across all diagnostic metrics (p < 0.001): sensitivity 98.91% vs. 95.91%, specificity 99.83% vs. 87.35%, and accuracy 99.53% vs. 90.11%.

unlisted_practices: delayed verification of positive AI alerts by specialists to manage false-positive burden without immediate cognitive interruption
